data.body: **P2:** Closing is checked only before entering the continuation. Step and wait-for-condition continuations can pass this check, block while retiring their previous worker, and then admit a fresh user worker after successful-output preparation has closed admission—or race past the owner check during invocation End. This permits new predicate/step side effects and checkpoints after root success was selected. Make user-worker admission atomic with the closing state, and test an admitted continuation held at the previous-worker handoff while serialization and End begin.
